title: Telecom 48 V Power Monitor
description: Designs bounded extra-low-voltage telecom power monitoring and supervised control boards.
constraints: Derive working-voltage, transient, clearance, and thermal assumptions from authoritative evidence.
Prevent monitoring and communications paths from defeating the chosen isolation boundary.
Represent input protection, fault energy, and reverse-polarity risks explicitly.
evidence_requirements: Official electrical and package documentation for selected protection, conversion, sensing, and isolation functions.
Applicable telecom input-transient guidance identified for the deployment context.
KiCad symbol-to-footprint and pin compatibility evidence.

verification: ERC and DRC findings are reported without concealment.
Protection, isolation, and thermal assumptions are independently reviewed.
Unverified compliance claims remain explicit open issues.
acceptance.delivery_policy: Produce reviewable engineering artifacts with an evidence ledger; do not represent the design as certified or field-ready without human approval.
